meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已有的口播 / 访谈 / 播客视频叠加按时间同步的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画),画布可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5,原片原样播放,产出 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词,或要求“包装 / 美化我的视频”时触发;纯字幕不做,交给 /embedded-captions,意图不清时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这条访谈视频加图形卡片,输出竖屏 9:16
say.note: 会先确认素材与画布比例,再逐张设计卡片

say.text: 用 graphic overlays 把我这段播客片段包装一下
say.note: 按转写文本设计卡片,原片完整保留

say.text: 帮我给这个口播视频做下三分之一标题和数据标注
say.note: 卡片内容取自视频里实际说的话

howto.what_en: Layers timed, designed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — onto an existing talking-head clip, synced to the transcript, then renders an MP4. The clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or ask to package/dress up your video. Not for plain subtitles (use embedded-captions); unclear cases route to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this interview clip, output 9:16 vertical
say_en.note: Confirms the clip and canvas, then designs each card

say_en.text: Package my podcast segment with graphic overlays
say_en.note: Cards are designed from the transcript; clip stays intact

say_en.text: Make lower-thirds and data callouts for this talking-head video
say_en.note: Card content comes from what is actually said
